experimental_design: Identification of Alexa 488 labeling sites in WT b5 and verification of site-specific labeling in T70C b5

To determine which amino acids had reacted with the Alexa 488 fluorophore, proteomic analysis of Alexa 488-WT-b5 was conducted... the presence of only a single labeled b5 peptide at the mutated Cys was confirmed by the proteomic analysis (Fig. 6, Tables S1, and S2, showing T70C b5 data)
